Usage: dotnet backlog renumber <OLD-ID> [<NEW-ID>] [--from <ref>] [--base <ref>] [--branch-tip <ref>] [--all] [--apply]
  <NEW-ID>            default: the next ID free in the working tree, on the base and in the branch's commits;
                      a given ID taken in any of them is refused
  --from <ref>        take your item from a commit (a rebase or merge collision); the working tree's file is kept
  --base <ref>        the base branch (default origin/<baseBranch in workflow.config.json>): its items are taken,
                      and references are rewritten
                      only in files changed since merge-base <ref> HEAD
  --branch-tip <ref>  the branch whose commits <base>..<ref> hold taken IDs (default: the tip a rebase in
                      progress started from, otherwise HEAD)
  --all               rewrite references in every file (a renumber with no collision)
  --apply             write the changes; without it, a dry run

result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet backlog log-summary <log-file> [--projects] [--expect <slnx>] [--files <path>...] [--warnings]
  --expect checks that every test project in the solution reported a result; a missing one makes the run INCOMPLETE.
  --files lists the compiler warnings in the given repo-relative .cs/.razor files, e.g. --files $(git diff --name-only HEAD).
  --warnings breaks every warning down by code and by project (use a clean-build log).
  Summarises a dotnet test log (pass/fail counts, failed tests) or a dotnet build log
  (error and warning totals), with compile errors de-duplicated and grouped by file.
  Exit codes: 0 pass, 2 test or build failure, 1 usage error, no result found, or a test project's result missing.

commands.payload:
Usage: dotnet backlog log-summary <log-file> [--projects] [--expect <slnx>] [--files <path>...] [--warnings]
  --expect checks that every test project in the solution reported a result; a missing one makes the run INCOMPLETE.
  --files lists the compiler warnings in the given repo-relative .cs/.razor files, e.g. --files $(git diff --name-only HEAD).
  --warnings breaks every warning down by code and by project (use a clean-build log).
  Summarises a dotnet test log (pass/fail counts, failed tests) or a dotnet build log
  (error and warning totals), with compile errors de-duplicated and grouped by file.
  Exit codes: 0 pass, 2 test or build failure, 1 usage error, no result found, or a test project's result missing.
